page.title: Everything you need to run an academy
page.description: A tour of what Atlas actually does — organized around the real parts of running an education business.

overview.title: One dashboard per academy
overview.description: See members, courses and activity for an academy without digging through settings screens.

provisioning.title: Set up in minutes
provisioning.description: A new academy is created, branded and reachable on its own subdomain in one guided flow.

branding.title: Your branding, everywhere
branding.description: Logo, colors and identity carry through the dashboard, the student experience, and the public website.

courses.title: Structured course content
courses.description: Organize courses into sections and lessons, with video and document content attached directly.

quizzes.title: Quizzes with real scoring
quizzes.description: Build quizzes with multiple question types and get automatic scoring as students complete them.

assignments.title: Assignments and submissions
assignments.description: Collect student submissions and grade them without emailing files back and forth.

students.title: Students belong to one academy
students.description: A student who signs up through your academy's own page is yours alone — never shared with another academy.

enrollment.title: Simple enrollment
enrollment.description: Enroll students into courses and track where each one stands at a glance.

progress.title: Real progress tracking
progress.description: Lesson-by-lesson completion and quiz results, visible to the student and to you.

teaching.title: A dedicated teaching dashboard
teaching.description: Instructors see their assigned courses, students and grading queue in one place.

grading.title: Grade quizzes and assignments
grading.description: Review submissions and quiz attempts without leaving the teaching dashboard.

scoped.title: Scoped to assigned courses
scoped.description: An instructor's access is limited to the courses they're actually assigned to teach.

builder.title: A real website builder
builder.description: Build your academy's public site from configurable sections — hero, courses, instructors, testimonials, FAQ and more.

themes.title: Professional themes
themes.description: Start from a theme designed for education businesses and adjust it to match your brand.

cms.title: Announcements and a blog
cms.description: Publish announcements and blog posts to your academy's audience without a separate content tool.

subdomains.title: Instant subdomains
subdomains.description: Every academy gets its own subdomain automatically the moment it's created — no DNS knowledge required.

customDomains.title: Connect your own domain
customDomains.description: Point a domain you already own at your academy's public site when you're ready.

ssl.title: HTTPS by default
ssl.description: Every academy subdomain and connected custom domain is served securely, automatically.

multiAcademy.title: Run more than one academy
multiAcademy.description: One organization can own several academies, each with its own branding, content and students.

roles.title: Owners, managers and staff
roles.description: Assign a manager to a specific academy without giving them access to your whole organization.

billing.title: Billing at the organization level
billing.description: One subscription covers the organization; academies underneath it share the same plan and usage limits.

dashboards.title: Enrollment and completion trends
dashboards.description: See how students are moving through your courses over time, not just a snapshot.

reporting.title: Date-range reporting
reporting.description: Look at activity over the exact period you care about, from the last week to the last quarter.

isolation.title: Database-level tenant isolation
isolation.description: Each academy's data is isolated at the database layer, not just filtered in the application — one customer's data cannot leak into another's, even through a direct API call.

auditLog.title: An audit trail you can trust
auditLog.description: Sensitive actions are recorded with who did what and when, for accountability across your organization.

infrastructure.title: Production infrastructure, not a prototype
infrastructure.description: Automated backups, encrypted credentials, and rate-limited APIs protect your academy's data and uptime.

cta.title: Ready to see it running your academy?
